# ====================================================================
# standalone/CMakeLists.txt - builds pdflib.dll: one self-contained DLL
# exporting the full libharu-style C API, with BOTH engines (libharu +
# PoDoFo) linked statically inside it.
#
# This is deliberately separate from the top-level CMakeLists.txt, which
# builds the core as a static library plus tests/examples. Here the only
# product is the DLL and the import library.
#
# Dependency discovery uses the CMakeDeps files generated by conan into
# ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generators, so point CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH (or the
# toolchain file) there - the build-*.cmd scripts do this for you.
#
# Targets:
#   pdflib            - the DLL (SHARED) + pdflib.lib import library
#   pdflib_smoke      - a self-checking consumer that loads/links the DLL
# ====================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

project(pdflib_dll
    VERSION 1.0.0
    DESCRIPTION "Single-DLL C ABI over libharu + PoDoFo"
    LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 14)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Repository root (this file lives in <root>/standalone/).
set(PDFLIB_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/..")
get_filename_component(PDFLIB_ROOT "${PDFLIB_ROOT}" ABSOLUTE)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Engines. Both are REQUIRED: the whole point of this DLL is to ship
# them together. Their imported targets come from conan's CMakeDeps
# output:
#   libharu-local::libharu-local   (local fork of the ConanCenter recipe)
#   podofo::podofo                 (bundled podofo-local recipe)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
find_package(libharu-local CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(podofo       CONFIG REQUIRED)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# The engine sources, shared by every product DLL.
#
# pdfx.dll is deliberately built from these same sources rather than
# linking pdflib.dll: the whole point of the standalone product is one
# self-contained file, and a pdfx.dll that dragged pdflib.dll along
# would be two files with a load-order dependency. Both DLLs therefore
# carry their own copy of the engine, and both keep the static CRT.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
set(PDFLIB_ENGINE_SOURCES
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/src/pdflib_export.c
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/pdf_core.c
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/pdf_init.c
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/backends/pdf_backend_dummy.c
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/backends/pdf_backend_libharu.c
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/backends/pdf_backend_podofo.cpp
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# The DLL.
#
# Sources: the engine-agnostic core, the always-present dummy backend,
# both real backends, and the export shim that pins the C ABI.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(pdflib SHARED
    ${PDFLIB_ENGINE_SOURCES}
    ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/src/pdflib.def
)

target_include_directories(pdflib
    PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}          # so #include "pdflib/pdf_api.h" works
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib   # so #include "pdf_backend.h" works
)

# Both engines are static; linking them into a DLL requires the whole
# archive to be pulled in, which the linker does for referenced objects.
target_link_libraries(pdflib PRIVATE
    libharu-local::libharu-local
    podofo::podofo
)

# Enable both backends in pdf_init.c, mark this as the DLL build so PDFAPI
# expands to __declspec(dllexport) on every core entry point, and keep the
# export names undecorated (pdflib.def is the authoritative list).
target_compile_definitions(pdflib PRIVATE
    PDFLIB_BUILDING
    PDFLIB_SHARED
    PDFLIB_BACKEND_LIBHARU_ENABLED
    PDFLIB_BACKEND_PODOFO_ENABLED
)

if(MSVC)
    # /EHa on the PoDoFo backend: PoDoFo can die with a hardware fault
    # (access violation) as well as with C++ throws, and /EHsc's catch
    # cannot see either of them reliably. We HAVE to catch both, because
    # an exception escaping the C ABI takes the host process with it -
    # fatal for a DLL that promises to be callable from any language.
    # /EHa also lets `catch (...)` translate a hardware fault into a
    # PDF_ERR_BACKEND_FAILED status code instead of a dead caller.
    #
    # The rest of the sources stay on /EHsc: the core and the other
    # backends are plain C, and keeping the C++ exception machinery out
    # of the whole DLL where possible is both faster and safer.
    set_source_files_properties(
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/backends/pdf_backend_podofo.cpp
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/EHa")
    # /utf-8: the sources contain non-ASCII commentary.
    target_compile_options(pdflib PRIVATE /utf-8 /W3)
    # The DLL owns its CRT statically (/MT) so it never needs the VC++
    # redistributable on the target machine. The conan packages were built
    # with compiler.runtime=static, so this matches.
    set_target_properties(pdflib PROPERTIES
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded"
        OUTPUT_NAME "pdflib"
        PREFIX ""
        SUFFIX ".dll"
    )
else()
    target_compile_options(pdflib PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter)
    set_target_properties(pdflib PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX ".dll")
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# pdfx.dll - the libharu-style API with the prefix swapped.
#
# This is what a libharu user gets: PDFX_New instead of HPDF_New,
# PDFX_AddPage instead of HPDF_AddPage, and the same argument order and
# return codes for the rest. The implementation is pdfx_compat.c, which
# is plain C over the pdf_* core - it never calls libharu itself, so the
# engine underneath is still chosen at run time (libharu or PoDoFo) by
# PDFX_SetBackend() or PDFLIB_BACKEND.
#
# Deliberately NOT linked against pdflib.dll: see PDFLIB_ENGINE_SOURCES.
# Also deliberately NOT compiled with PDFLIB_PDFX_BUILD_DLL, so no
# __declspec(dllexport) decorates anything and pdfx.def is the single
# source of truth for the export table. On x86 that is the difference
# between exporting PDFX_New and exporting _PDFX_New@4.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX "Build pdfx.dll (libharu-style PDFX_* API)" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX)
    add_library(pdfx SHARED
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/pdfx_compat.c
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/pdfx.def
        ${PDFLIB_ENGINE_SOURCES})

    target_include_directories(pdfx
        PUBLIC
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include
        PRIVATE
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}          # #include "pdflib/pdf_api.h"
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib   # #include "pdf_backend.h"
    )

    target_link_libraries(pdfx PRIVATE
        libharu-local::libharu-local
        podofo::podofo)

    # PDFLIB_SHARED is intentionally absent: it would make PDFAPI expand to
    # __declspec(dllexport) on every pdf_* entry point and add a second,
    # decorated set of exports alongside the .def list. Inside this DLL the
    # pdf_* symbols are ordinary externals resolved at link time.
    target_compile_definitions(pdfx PRIVATE
        PDFLIB_BUILDING
        PDFLIB_BACKEND_LIBHARU_ENABLED
        PDFLIB_BACKEND_PODOFO_ENABLED)

    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_definitions(pdfx PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
        target_compile_options(pdfx PRIVATE /utf-8 /W3)
        set_target_properties(pdfx PROPERTIES
            MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded"
            OUTPUT_NAME "pdfx"
            PREFIX ""
            SUFFIX ".dll")
    else()
        target_compile_options(pdfx PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter)
        set_target_properties(pdfx PROPERTIES PREFIX "" SUFFIX ".dll")
    endif()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# libharu-compatible facade (HPDF_*).
#
# This is a *source/link* compatibility layer, not a second copy of the
# libharu engine. It implements the libharu public API over the pdf_* core,
# so an existing libharu program can be recompiled against compat/include
# and linked with hpdf.lib (static) or pdflib_hpdf.lib (DLL), while
# HPDF_SetBackend()/PDFLIB_BACKEND selects libharu or PoDoFo underneath.
#
# The static library is deliberately called hpdf.lib: replacing libharu's
# import/static library with it is the whole point. The DLL is called
# pdflib_hpdf.dll because a real libharu hpdf.dll may coexist on the
# machine and the two use different calling conventions/ABIs.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_HPDF_COMPAT "Build the libharu-compatible HPDF facade" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_HPDF_COMPAT)
    set(PDFLIB_HPDF_HEADERS
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include/hpdf.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include/hpdf_types.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include/hpdf_consts.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include/hpdf_errors.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include/hpdf_config.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include/hpdf_version.h)

    add_library(hpdf STATIC
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/hpdf_compat.c
        ${PDFLIB_HPDF_HEADERS})
    target_include_directories(hpdf
        PUBLIC  ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include
        PRIVATE ${PDFLIB_ROOT})
    target_link_libraries(hpdf PUBLIC pdflib)
    set_target_properties(hpdf PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME hpdf)

    add_library(pdflib_hpdf SHARED
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/hpdf_compat.c
        ${PDFLIB_HPDF_HEADERS})
    target_include_directories(pdflib_hpdf
        PUBLIC  ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include
        PRIVATE ${PDFLIB_ROOT})
    target_link_libraries(pdflib_hpdf PRIVATE pdflib)
    target_compile_definitions(pdflib_hpdf PRIVATE PDFLIB_HPDF_BUILD_DLL)
    set_target_properties(pdflib_hpdf PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME pdflib_hpdf)

    if(MSVC)
        foreach(tgt hpdf pdflib_hpdf)
            target_compile_definitions(${tgt} PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
            target_compile_options(${tgt} PRIVATE /W3 /utf-8)
        endforeach()
        set_target_properties(pdflib_hpdf PROPERTIES
            MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded")
    else()
        foreach(tgt hpdf pdflib_hpdf)
            target_compile_options(${tgt} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
        endforeach()
    endif()

    # A small self-checking consumer plus the unmodified libharu demos. The
    # demos are the strongest source-compatibility test: they are literally
    # upstream's demo sources, compiled against compat/include/hpdf.h.
    add_executable(hpdf_compat_smoke
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/tests/hpdf_smoke.c)
    target_include_directories(hpdf_compat_smoke PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT})
    target_link_libraries(hpdf_compat_smoke PRIVATE hpdf)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_definitions(hpdf_compat_smoke PRIVATE
                                   _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
        target_compile_options(hpdf_compat_smoke PRIVATE /W3 /utf-8)
    endif()

    set(PDFLIB_HPDF_DEMOS text_demo line_demo arc_demo link_annotation)
    foreach(demo ${PDFLIB_HPDF_DEMOS})
        add_executable(hpdf_demo_${demo}
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/tests/${demo}.c
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/tests/grid_sheet.c)
        target_include_directories(hpdf_demo_${demo} PRIVATE
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/include
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/compat/tests)
        target_link_libraries(hpdf_demo_${demo} PRIVATE hpdf)
        if(MSVC)
            target_compile_definitions(hpdf_demo_${demo} PRIVATE
                                       _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
            target_compile_options(hpdf_demo_${demo} PRIVATE /W3 /utf-8)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install: DLL + import lib + headers.
#
# The public header (include/pdflib.h) does #include "pdflib/pdf_api.h",
# so the include tree must keep that relative shape: install pdflib.h at
# the include root and the engine headers under include/pdflib/.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
install(TARGETS pdflib
    RUNTIME DESTINATION .
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/include/pdflib.h DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdflib/
    DESTINATION include/pdflib
    FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h")

if(PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX)
    # pdfx.dll ships with its own headers and import library. A consumer
    # needs pdfx/include/pdfx*.h and pdfx.lib, nothing else: the engine is
    # inside the DLL.
    install(TARGETS pdfx
        RUNTIME DESTINATION .
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
    install(FILES
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include/pdfx.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include/pdfx_types.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include/pdfx_consts.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include/pdfx_errors.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include/pdfx_config.h
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include/pdfx_version.h
        DESTINATION include/pdfx)
endif()

if(PDFLIB_BUILD_HPDF_COMPAT)
    install(TARGETS hpdf pdflib_hpdf
        RUNTIME DESTINATION .
        ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
        LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
    install(FILES ${PDFLIB_HPDF_HEADERS} DESTINATION include)
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Smoke test: links the import library and drives a real document
# through both backends, including the streamed path.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_SMOKE "Build the DLL smoke test" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_SMOKE)
    add_executable(pdflib_smoke ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/standalone/smoke.c)
    # The smoke test includes "pdflib.h", which in turn includes
    # "pdflib/pdf_api.h" - so both the include/ root and the repo root
    # (which contains pdflib/) must be on the search path.
    target_include_directories(pdflib_smoke PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/include
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT})
    target_link_libraries(pdflib_smoke PRIVATE pdflib)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(pdflib_smoke PRIVATE /W3)
    endif()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# zlib, shared by the two self-checking tests.
#
# Both apitest and the showcase read their own output back (see
# standalone/pdf_inspect.h), and FlateDecode needs zlib. zlib is already
# in the dependency graph as a PoDoFo dependency, so this adds no new
# download - only a link.
#
# CAVEAT: the zlib recipe in this conan cache exports ZLIB::ZLIB with an
# EMPTY INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES. Its data file literally has
#     set(zlib_INCLUDE_DIRS_RELEASE )
# so ZLIBTargets.cmake does
#     set_property(TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB APPEND PROPERTY
#                  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES
#                  $<$<CONFIG:Release>:${zlib_INCLUDE_DIRS_RELEASE}>)
# i.e. it appends an empty list. The library links fine (zlib.lib is
# resolved through INTERFACE_LINK_DIRECTORIES) but the header search path
# stays empty, and #include <zlib.h> dies with C1083. Repair the include
# directory from the package folder the same recipe DID export, so this
# keeps working whichever hash the conan cache holds.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_SHOWCASE "Build the complex-document showcase" ON)

set(PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR "")
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_APITEST OR PDFLIB_BUILD_SHOWCASE)
    find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)

    if(DEFINED zlib_PACKAGE_FOLDER_RELEASE
       AND EXISTS "${zlib_PACKAGE_FOLDER_RELEASE}/include/zlib.h")
        set(PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR "${zlib_PACKAGE_FOLDER_RELEASE}/include")
    elseif(DEFINED zlib_PACKAGE_FOLDER_DEBUG
           AND EXISTS "${zlib_PACKAGE_FOLDER_DEBUG}/include/zlib.h")
        set(PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR "${zlib_PACKAGE_FOLDER_DEBUG}/include")
    else()
        # Not a conan-shaped package (or the recipe changed): fall back to
        # a plain header search, hinting at whatever the target claims.
        get_target_property(_zlib_iface_incs ZLIB::ZLIB INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
        find_path(PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR zlib.h
                  HINTS ${_zlib_iface_incs} ${ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR})
    endif()

    if(NOT PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "zlib was found but zlib.h could not be located. The conan "
            "recipe exports no include directory, so set "
            "PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR by hand or add the header to a "
            "directory on the include path.")
    endif()
    message(STATUS "pdflib: zlib headers from ${PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR}")
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# API coverage test: calls every one of the exported entry points and
# asserts on the result. tools/check_api_coverage.py diffs this source
# against src/pdflib.def so a new export cannot ship untested.
#
# apitest.c includes "image_samples.h" from its own directory (the PNG /
# JPEG samples are embedded there so the image tests need no external
# files), hence the CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR entry.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_APITEST "Build the full API coverage test" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_APITEST)
    add_executable(pdflib_apitest ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/standalone/apitest.c)
    target_include_directories(pdflib_apitest PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/include
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    target_include_directories(pdflib_apitest PRIVATE ${PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(pdflib_apitest PRIVATE pdflib ZLIB::ZLIB)
    if(MSVC)
        # The test reads files with fopen/snprintf, which MSVC's
        # deprecation pass flags on every call. Silencing it keeps the
        # build log readable so a real warning stands out.
        target_compile_definitions(pdflib_apitest PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
        target_compile_options(pdflib_apitest PRIVATE /W3)
    endif()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Showcase: builds a deliberately complex, production-shaped PDF (cover,
# chapters of wrapped text, vector art, colour ramps, transparency,
# images, annotations, a table, a custom rotated page, a bookmark tree)
# and then reads its own output back with standalone/pdf_inspect.h.
#
# It lives here rather than in examples/ because it needs the inspector
# and zlib, and because it is a test as much as a demo.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_SHOWCASE)
    add_executable(pdflib_showcase ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/examples/showcase_pdf.c)
    target_include_directories(pdflib_showcase PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/include
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})     # pdf_inspect.h
    target_include_directories(pdflib_showcase PRIVATE ${PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(pdflib_showcase PRIVATE pdflib ZLIB::ZLIB)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_definitions(pdflib_showcase PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
        # /utf-8: the CJK sample string is a UTF-8 literal, and without
        # this MSVC would re-encode it into the local code page and the
        # bytes handed to pdflib would not be valid UTF-8.
        target_compile_options(pdflib_showcase PRIVATE /W3 /utf-8)
    endif()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Regression repro for the save-path crash: drives all four save modes
# and cross-checks the artefacts. Kept as a separate program because it
# is the smallest thing that reproduces the historical failure, so it
# stays useful when the big suites are unavailable.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_REPRO "Build the save-path regression repro" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_REPRO)
    add_executable(pdflib_rsave ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/standalone/repro-save.c)
    target_include_directories(pdflib_rsave PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/include
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT})
    target_link_libraries(pdflib_rsave PRIVATE pdflib)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(pdflib_rsave PRIVATE /W3)
    endif()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Examples. They are integration checks in their own right: feature_pdf
# writes the same document through the path, handle, stream and streamed
# writers, and streamed_pdf exercises the incremental writer. Building
# them here keeps "one command builds and verifies everything" true.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build the example programs" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    foreach(example hello_pdf feature_pdf streamed_pdf)
        add_executable(${example} ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/examples/${example}.c)
        target_include_directories(${example} PRIVATE
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/include
            ${PDFLIB_ROOT})
        target_link_libraries(${example} PRIVATE pdflib)
        if(MSVC)
            target_compile_options(${example} PRIVATE /W3)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# pdfx_showcase: a libharu program that links pdfx.
#
# The source includes only "pdfx.h" and calls only PDFX_*. If this builds
# and produces a correct document, the facade is source-compatible with a
# libharu program that had its prefix swapped - which is the whole claim.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
option(PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX_SHOWCASE "Build the pdfx libharu-style test" ON)
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX AND PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX_SHOWCASE)
    add_executable(pdfx_showcase ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/tests/pdfx_showcase.c)
    target_include_directories(pdfx_showcase PRIVATE
        ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/pdfx/include
        ${PDFLIB_ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(pdfx_showcase PRIVATE pdfx ZLIB::ZLIB)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_definitions(pdfx_showcase PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
        target_compile_options(pdfx_showcase PRIVATE /W3 /utf-8)
    endif()
endif()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test registration. `ctest` then runs the whole verification chain in
# one go: the API coverage test on both engines, the smoke test, the
# save-path repro, and the examples.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
enable_testing()

if(PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX AND PDFLIB_BUILD_PDFX_SHOWCASE)
    # --selftest: build both documents and assert on the serialised bytes
    # in memory. File output is exercised separately (--stdout, redirected
    # by the caller) because a sandboxed runner may not let a child process
    # create files at all.
    add_test(NAME pdfx_showcase COMMAND pdfx_showcase --selftest all)
endif()

if(PDFLIB_BUILD_APITEST)
    add_test(NAME apitest_all COMMAND pdflib_apitest all apitest)
endif()
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_SHOWCASE)
    add_test(NAME showcase COMMAND pdflib_showcase all showcase)
endif()
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_SMOKE)
    add_test(NAME smoke COMMAND pdflib_smoke)
endif()
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_REPRO)
    add_test(NAME rsave COMMAND pdflib_rsave)
endif()
if(PDFLIB_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    add_test(NAME hello_pdf   COMMAND hello_pdf)
    add_test(NAME feature_pdf COMMAND feature_pdf)
    add_test(NAME streamed_pdf COMMAND streamed_pdf)
endif()

if(PDFLIB_BUILD_HPDF_COMPAT)
    add_test(NAME hpdf_compat_smoke COMMAND hpdf_compat_smoke)
    # Upstream libharu demos, compiled unchanged. They write <argv0>.pdf and
    # return 0 only when every HPDF_* call succeeded.
    foreach(demo ${PDFLIB_HPDF_DEMOS})
        add_test(NAME hpdf_demo_${demo} COMMAND hpdf_demo_${demo})
    endforeach()
endif()

# The coverage check is a static source comparison, so it needs no build
# output - only an interpreter. Skip it silently when there is none.
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)
if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
    add_test(NAME api_coverage
             COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
                     ${PDFLIB_ROOT}/tools/check_api_coverage.py)
endif()
